description.value:
Whenever you create a Reanimated Companion, it gains one of the following options of your choice, chosen when you create it.

Arcane Conduit. You can cast spells as though you were in the companion's space, using your own senses. Once per turn, when you cast an Artificer spell of the Evocation or Necromancy school that deals damage while your companion is within 120 feet of you, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of that spell.

Ferocity. The damage die of the companion's Dreadful Swipe increases to 1d6.
